svg.text: Steering-column torque against speed: before D-075 and now
Magnitude of the torque the physics sends to the force-feedback pipeline, N·m. Same scripted driver, hand-limited steering, both models.
Tern GT: Ridgeline lap (scripted, every 50 ms)
Halden E4: Ridgeline lap (scripted, every 50 ms)
before: fixed assist share (0 for the Tern GT, 0.36 for the Halden E4), no rack friction, inertia or gyroscopic moment
now: speed-sensitive assist, rack friction and inertia, gyroscopic and weight moments at the kingpins
